map.输入各竞品销售额，计算市场占有率、CR4 集中度与 HHI 指数，评估行业竞争格: Enter each competitor's sales to compute market share, CR4 concentration and the HHI index, assessing industry competition and monopoly degree.
map.年报/融资材料里算自家在行业中的占比。: Compute your own share of the industry for annual reports or fundraising materials.
map.对比多家竞品份额画份额条看集中度。: Compare the shares of several competitors with share bars to see concentration.
map.监控季度份额波动判断攻守态势。: Monitor quarterly share movement to judge offensive or defensive posture.
map.：A 营收 600 万、B 300 万、C 100 万，行业总 1000 万 →: : A revenue 6,000,000, B 3,000,000, C 1,000,000, industry total 10,000,000 -> A holds 60%, B 30%, C 10%; A is the leader but B + C at 40% combined still have room to catch up.
map.：去年营收 200 万占 20%，今年 260 万但行业扩到 1500 万 →: : last year revenue 2,000,000 was a 20% share; this year revenue is 2,600,000 but the industry grew to 15,000,000 -> share fell to 17.3%, more volume at a lower price, which warrants caution.
map.份额用营收还是销量算？: Should share be computed from revenue or units?
map.两者都行，含义不同。营收份额看金额话语权，销量份额看走量能力，高端品两者差异大。: Either works, but they mean different things. Revenue share shows pricing power in money terms, unit share shows volume capability, and for premium products the two diverge a lot.
map.份额下降一定是坏事吗？: Is a falling share always bad?
map.不一定。行业高速扩张时份额降但绝对收入涨，属正常；若份额和收入同降才是真预警。: Not necessarily. When an industry is expanding fast, share can fall while absolute revenue rises, which is normal; a real warning is when share and revenue fall together.
